_about: The 11 public documents the 1MDB demo case is read from (app/services/demo_1mdb.py). They are downloaded from these addresses when the demo is loaded; the app does not ship their files. PDFs are pinned by sha256; regulator web pages change their markup, so they are not. 'admitted' marks documents whose facts were admitted, pleaded to or found by a regulator, rather than alleged in a civil complaint.

documents.title: MAS directs BSI Bank to shut down in Singapore
documents.why_it_matters: Singapore withdraws BSI Bank's merchant-bank status and fines it S$13.3M for 41 AML breaches tied to 1MDB-related flows, and refers six named BSI managers and staff (including former CEO Hans Peter Brunner and Yeo Jiawei) to the Public Prosecutor; MAS calls it the worst case of control lapses it had seen.
documents.licence_note: © Monetary Authority of Singapore. MAS Terms of Use: no reproduction/republication without MAS's prior written permission, except one copy for personal non-commercial use; obtain permission (or link/quote briefly) before redistributing the text in the app

documents.title: BSI in serious breach of money laundering regulations
documents.why_it_matters: FINMA finds BSI AG seriously breached AML rules through 1MDB-linked PEP relationships that top management knowingly kept, orders CHF 95M disgorgement, opens proceedings against two former top managers and requires BSI's dissolution into EFG.
documents.licence_note: © FINMA. FINMA terms and conditions: any reproduction requires FINMA's prior written consent; obtain permission (or link/quote briefly) before redistributing the text in the app

documents.title: United States v. Real Property Located in New York, New York (Park Laurel Condominium) — Verified Complaint for Forfeiture In Rem, C.D. Cal. No. 2:16-cv-05371
documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice (filed in U.S. District Court, C.D. Cal.)
documents.why_it_matters: The founding DOJ narrative: traces 1MDB money through the Good Star/PetroSaudi, Aabar-BVI (Goldman 2012 bonds) and Tanore (2013 bond) phases via BSI, Falcon and AmBank accounts to Jho Low, Riza Aziz/Red Granite and 'Malaysian Official 1', and lists the first ~$1B of US-linked assets.
documents.licence_note: Public court record; US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)

documents.title: MAS Directs Falcon Bank to Cease Operations in Singapore; Financial Penalties Imposed on DBS Bank and UBS
documents.why_it_matters: Shuts Falcon Private Bank's Singapore branch (owned by Aabar Investments PJS) with S$4.3M in penalties and notes the arrest of its branch manager, and fines DBS (S$1M) and UBS (S$1.3M) for AML lapses on 1MDB-related fund flows.
documents.licence_note: © Monetary Authority of Singapore. MAS Terms of Use: no reproduction/republication without MAS's prior written permission, except one copy for personal non-commercial use; obtain permission (or link/quote briefly) before redistributing the text in the app

documents.title: United States v. All Right and Title to the Yacht M/Y Equanimity — Verified Complaint for Forfeiture In Rem, C.D. Cal. No. 2:17-cv-04441
documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice (filed in U.S. District Court, C.D. Cal.; copy from CourtListener RECAP)
documents.why_it_matters: The June 2017 expanded complaint (one of a set of related filings on 15 June 2017 seeking ~$540M) that adds the 'Options Buyback' phase to the Good Star, Aabar-BVI and Tanore phases, and traces funds to Low's superyacht Equanimity, Red Granite films (Dumb and Dumber To, Daddy's Home), artworks and jewellery.
documents.licence_note: Public court record; US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)

documents.title: United States v. Low Taek Jho and Ng Chong Hwa — Indictment, E.D.N.Y. No. 18-CR-538 (MKB)
documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice / U.S. Attorney's Office, E.D.N.Y.
documents.why_it_matters: Grand-jury indictment (returned 3 Oct 2018, unsealed 1 Nov 2018) charging Jho Low and Goldman banker Roger Ng with FCPA and money-laundering conspiracies over the 2012–13 Goldman-arranged 1MDB bonds; the core criminal charging document. Scanned with OCR text layer, so expect some OCR errors.
documents.licence_note: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)

documents.title: United States v. Tim Leissner — Information, E.D.N.Y. No. 18-CR-439 (MKB)
documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice / U.S. Attorney's Office, E.D.N.Y.
documents.why_it_matters: Two-count criminal information (FCPA conspiracy and money-laundering conspiracy) to which ex-Goldman Southeast Asia chairman Tim Leissner pleaded guilty under seal in 2018 (made public 1 Nov 2018); describes bribes to Malaysian and Abu Dhabi officials for the Magnolia, Maximus and Catalyze bonds. Date is the unsealing date.
documents.licence_note: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)

documents.title: United States v. Real Property Located in London, United Kingdom (Red Mountain Global Ltd.) — Verified Complaint for Forfeiture In Rem, C.D. Cal. No. 2:19-cv-01326
documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice (filed in U.S. District Court, C.D. Cal.)
documents.why_it_matters: Feb 2019 complaint against a London property held via Red Mountain Global Ltd. for former 1MDB general counsel Jasmine Loo, filed alongside the Oceana 57 sale proceeds and 'Company 1' (McFarland) funds; restates the full scheme and adds how 1MDB insiders were paid.
documents.licence_note: Public court record; US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)

documents.title: United States v. The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. — Deferred Prosecution Agreement with Statement of Facts, E.D.N.Y. Cr. No. 20-437 (MKB)
documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice, Criminal Division (Fraud Section, MLARS) and U.S. Attorney's Office, E.D.N.Y.
documents.why_it_matters: Goldman Sachs' admission of an FCPA bribery conspiracy; the attached Statement of Facts is the bank's own agreed account of how Leissner, Ng and Low paid bribes to Malaysian and Abu Dhabi officials to win the three 1MDB bond deals ($6.5B raised, ~$600M in fees). Kind is an agreement rather than a court order.
documents.licence_note: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)

documents.title: In the Matter of The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. — Order to Cease and Desist and Order of Assessment of a Civil Money Penalty Issued Upon Consent (Docket Nos. 20-018-B-HC, 20-018-CMP-HC)
documents.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
documents.why_it_matters: The Fed's $154M penalty and consent order finding Goldman failed to maintain oversight, controls and risk management over 1MDB-related business, with required improvements to its board oversight, compliance risk management and controls.
documents.licence_note: US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)

documents.title: United States v. The Sum of $20,000,000 in Funds and Securities Traceable to UBS Account No. XX-XX715-WB and Fidelity Investment Account No. XXXX XX7922 — Verified Complaint for Forfeiture In Rem, C.D. Cal. No. 2:25-cv-00474
documents.publisher: U.S. Department of Justice (filed in U.S. District Court, C.D. Cal.)
documents.why_it_matters: Short, recent (Jan 2025) complaint that summarises the four phases and seeks $20M in UBS/Fidelity holdings traced to a business venture linked to former Aabar executive Mohamed Al-Husseiny, showing asset recovery still continuing.
documents.licence_note: Public court record; US federal government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. § 105)
